query: Our production backend is considering axios@1.14.1 from GitHub repository axios/axios. Is this release safe to install? Investigate supply-chain advisories and malicious dependencies.
answer:
Target:   axios/axios @ 9f0f4dd · axios@1.14.1 · checked 2026-11-21
Decision: 🔴 Do not adopt — Do not use: malicious release

Do not install 1.14.1: published malicious release. If it was ever installed, treat that machine as
compromised and rotate every secret it could reach. Upgrade to 1.20.0 or later (newest fixed version
in the advisories), pin it and re-check before release.

Why
 🟢 Licence: MIT licence allows commercial use, with copyright notice kept.
   • LICENSE:3 The licence is MIT, which lets you use the code commercially with few conditions.
     "Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software" → https://github.com/axios/axios/blob/9f0f4ddfe72b4c06afafe1a658e6ee53d35b5760/LICENSE#L3 ✔
 🔴 Security: axios 1.14.1 on npm is listed as published malware. (CRA Art. 13(5))
   • Version 1.14.1 is a known malicious release (GHSA-fw8c-xr5c-95f9, MAL-2026-2307).
     "Malicious code in axios (npm)" → https://osv.dev/vulnerability/MAL-2026-2307 ✔
   • [suspicious · other] Version 1.14.1 of axios on npm is flagged as malicious. Do not install it.
     "Malicious code in axios (npm)" → https://osv.dev/vulnerability/MAL-2026-2307 ✔
   🔴 1.14.1: malicious release: GHSA-fw8c-xr5c-95f9, MAL-2026-2307
   🟡 1.14.0: previous release (not asked): 34 known advisories, not a safe pin

What to do next
 1. Do not install axios 1.14.1. Block it in your lockfile and package registry or proxy, and check
   that no build pipeline resolves to it.
 2. Search all lockfiles, CI logs and container images for axios 1.14.1 (and 0.30.4). If either was
   ever installed, treat that machine as compromised and rotate all secrets, tokens and keys it
   could reach.
 3. Choose a replacement version only after running a fresh advisory check on it. No advisory is not
   proof of a clean package.

Limitations
 • Open question: Has axios 1.14.1 (or 0.30.4) already been installed on any developer machine, CI
   runner or production server?
